description: Full-text search of The Korean Today articles, newest first. Korean keywords work best for the Korean edition; use lang for another edition or to get translated summaries.

lang.description: Language code. Edition codes (own articles): ko, en, fr, zh, ja, vi, th, id, lo, es, pt, ar, de, mn, ru. Any of the 87 AI summary languages (e.g. vi, th, hi, sw, zh-CN, pt-BR) returns Korean articles with a translated title and summary. Default ko.

section.description: Section slug from list_sections (e.g. society, economy, k-culture, technology).

name: search_articles
title: Search articles
